title: Which Alien Beanie Landed in Your Dental Lab?
html:
If you’ve got an Alien Beanie tucked in a drawer, hanging by the door, or still in your Lab Day bag, go grab it. The Official Editions archive is live, and you can finally see which edition of the Alien Milling Technologies’ hat you own. Match the colors on your beanie to the photos, find out what year it came from, and see how many you recognize along the way.

It Began With a Cold February in Chicago

Alien Milling Technologies made the first Alien Beanies in 2021 for dental lab techs coming to LMT Lab Day Chicago. The idea was simple. It’s February in Chicago, and everyone could use something warm to wear. We even put it on the label: “Keeping you cozy.”

Most Alien Beanies have been handed out at dental lab trade shows over the years. Then we started seeing techs post their beanies on social media. People remembered which colors they got, showed off the ones they still wore, and looked forward to seeing what we’d bring next. So, we gave the beanies a home of their own.

Find Yours in the Official Editions Archive

The Official Editions archive brings every official Alien Beanie together by year. If you own a few, line them up and see if you can place each one. The cuff, embroidered Alien logo, and tag are good clues when 2 editions appear similar. You might even remember the show where you picked yours up.

Found yours? Hit Remix to open it in the designer. Keep the colors you love and see what happens when you change just one part. Some editions are still available, while others have officially left planet Earth.

Design the One You’d Wear Next

In the Alien Beanie designer, tap the crown, cuff, Alien logo, or tag and watch the beanie photo change as you pick colors. There are more than 250 yarn colors to play with. You can give the tag a leather finish with embossed lettering or choose polyester and pick a separate color for the “milling” lettering.

Give your design a name and share it with your lab, or submit it as an idea for a future edition. Alien Milling Technologies will email you a picture and the color codes so you can keep a copy of what you made.

Your Design Could Be Next Year’s Edition

Browse Community Designs to see what other people have made and give your favorites a thumbs-up. If you opt in when you submit, your design can be featured there once it’s approved. A community favorite could become an official edition next year. Imagine spotting your colorway across the room at Lab Day.

Find your beanie in the Official Editions archive

Check out this new Speaking of Dentistry the Editor’s Cut Podcast episode from Dentistry Today featuring Saro Hatzakortzian, CEO of Alien Milling Technologies, who sat down with Senior Managing Editor Stan Goff to discuss the company’s growth, dental milling services, and advancements in zirconia materials.

Alien Milling Technologies offers a variety of zirconia materials and milling servives, including Alien HT and Alien Multi-Layer 2.0. Alien Multi-Layer 2.0 is part of the company’s Alien Zirconia Collection, which was named to the 4th Annual Editors’ Choice Awards in the October 2026 issue of Dentistry Today.
